name: Cleancell
_note: Added 2026-09-17 for the live Amperage Capital deal (56 units). orgId is cleancell.us — the domain of robert.bucher@cleancell.us, which is ALSO their website (verified 2026-09-17: resolves, HTTP 200, MX smtp.google.com, so it is a real Workspace domain and passes the work-email gate in api/_lib/public-domains.js). ⚠ THE LIVE RECORD IS UNDER THE WRONG KEY AND THIS FILE IS THE CORRECTION. Thomas created omega_orgs/cleancellusa.com by hand on 2026-09-16 with a paid tier and addons already set. cleancellusa.com does NOT EXIST — NXDOMAIN, checked 2026-09-17. Because orgId IS the email domain, that account is reachable only by someone mailing from @cleancellusa.com, so nobody at Clean Cell can sign in to it and none of what was bought is reachable. tier/addons/dates here are copied from that record rather than invented, so a seed run reproduces what he decided instead of repricing a paying account to a trial. The invoice amount is deliberately NOT in this file: plan() in scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js does not read it, and a contract value does not belong in the repo. The migration itself (create cleancell.us, repoint tenant_public/cleancell.clearskyomega.com, FLAG the old record without deleting it — CLAUDE.md, never delete in a migration) is a Firestore write and is NOT done by this file. NAME — three spellings are in play. Thomas's record says 'Cleancell', which is what this file now matches so a seed does not rename his account; cleancell.us calls itself 'Clean Cell US'; clearsky-cost-estimator.html carries a battery brand { key: 'cleancells', name: 'Clean Cells' }. That estimator entry is a BRAND in a dropdown, not a tenant, and was deliberately left alone — renaming a brand key silently rewrites saved estimates. RECEIVER VS ORIGINATOR. receivesFullBom is false because Clean Cell is the MIRROR of FENECON: Fenecon is an OEM that RECEIVES quote requests, Clean Cell is an originator that SENDS an opportunity out. Read that carefully — false is also the default for every tenant, so it does not positively say 'originator', and there is no field that does: plan() in scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js copies a fixed key list, so an invented key never reaches Firestore. Originator identity is recorded PER DEAL by omega-originator.js as originatorOrgId. requiredTools pins the financing marketplace, which is this deal's route to Amperage. HOSTNAME: cleancell.clearskyomega.com does not resolve — there is no wildcard DNS for *.clearskyomega.com, and budderfly./eastwestenergy./walters. are the same. Until it is attached in Vercel they sign in on silmarillion.clearskyomega.com, an OPEN_HOST that resolves the workspace from the email domain.

_noteWhiteLabel: WHITE LABEL, added 2026-09-18. Clean Cell sells on cleancell.us; ClearSky fulfils. See docs/WHITE-LABEL.md for the whole design. FIVE THINGS ARE NOT DONE BY THIS FILE and each one is a decision somebody has to make, not a field to fill in. (1) PRODUCTS IS EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Nothing is orderable until real SKUs are published into omega_orgs/cleancell.us/storefront/config.products, and inventing them here would put fictional equipment in front of a paying customer's customers. Note clearsky-cost-estimator.html carries a battery BRAND { key:'cleancells', name:'Clean Cells' } - that is a dropdown entry, not a SKU, and it has no price. With products empty the storefront still works: it sizes, it takes the enquiry, and it says we will come back with options, which is true. (2) THE COST BASIS (storefront.capexPerKwh / capexPerKw) IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. It is Clean Cell's negotiated buy price and this file is committed source - seed-omega-orgs.js THROWS if either key appears here. Set them directly in Firestore. Until then the sizer sweeps on the engine defaults in api/_lib/bess-engine.js, which are generic and will mis-rank the recommendation for their actual equipment. (3) showEconomics IS FALSE. Turning it on publishes an annual saving off the customer's own tariff, and a payback only where a product carries a published list price - never off the cost basis (api/embed-size.js explains why at length). That is a marketing call. (4) NO EMBED KEY EXISTS YET: run scripts/seed-embed-key.js --org cleancell.us --origins https://cleancell.us,.cleancell.us --apply. (5) HOSTNAME. cleancell.clearskyomega.com still does not resolve - there is no wildcard DNS for *.clearskyomega.com - so the loader snippet on cleancell.us would load nothing. Either attach that hostname in Vercel or point the snippet at silmarillion.clearskyomega.com, which does resolve. ATTRIBUTION: 'powered-by' on the signed-in chrome (their staff know whose platform it is and the contract has not said otherwise), 'none' on the public storefront (their customer is on their website and there is only one company in that conversation). Both are contract terms - change them when the paper says to, not to tidy this file.
